name: picturefill
description: A responsive image polyfill for <picture>, srcset, sizes, and more

latest_release.name: Picturefill 3.0.3
latest_release.body:
JavaScript module sizes and how they're ludicrous is a hot topic on the internet these days, eh? Well, we here at Picturefill are not ones to miss out on a good trend. Thanks to @gpittarelli we've reduced the installed size of Picturefill by about 98%.

For those of you concerned that this means 98% of your responsive images won't be polyfilled, fear not. We're only being polite to your disk space and not installing a full copy of the [examples](https://github.com/scottjehl/picturefill/tree/master/examples) directory (and various other small fried fish, by comparison) each time you install Picturefill. These examples are, of course, available on the wider interwebs, should you need them.

Official Release Notes ™:
- add .npmignore file (via #674)
